constraints: Warning and emergency colors appear only on event timeline branches and legend.
Remove hero, slogans, numbered stages and explanatory section subtext.
Compact data tables; details appear on demand.
Use smooth anchor scrolling and respect reduced motion.
Timeline positions represent event order, with actual timestamps; spacing is not elapsed time.
decisions.inspiration: 21st modern timeline inspected through Exa; implemented with existing native DOM/SVG primitives.

decisions.choice: How it works page with five-node architecture and ten-slide illustrated presentation
constraints: Top-right gray button with white text and slight rounding.
Two short bullets per slide; no em dashes or marketing slogans.
Native animated SVG with pause and reduced-motion support.
Illustrations distinguished from live scans; notification preview and model limitations explicit.
decisions.inspiration: 21st Animated Card Diagram inspected through Exa; existing native DOM/SVG primitives retained.

decisions.choice: Soft blue presentation accent and consistent slide spacing
constraints: Apply blue to presentation headings, diagram highlights and controls.
Use shared title baselines, bullet positions and diagram frames across ten slides.
Remove figcaptions, repeated topic labels and explanatory page footers.
Keep synthetic fixture and notification preview status in the slide content.

decisions.choice: Compact operational dashboard with timeline previews and persistent inspector
constraints: Unified compact control panel with actual overview counts; no separate empty action row.
Grayscale panels, consistent spacing and sidebar icons; warning and emergency colors reserved for timeline branches.
Hover or keyboard focus previews events; click or Enter opens persistent inspection.
Preview dismissal survives focus restoration on new-event polling.
Human scan-context labels keep at least 160px separation, including interleaved lifecycle events.
Recent activity is visible; alerts and scans share columns only on wide screens.
Read real persisted records. Do not add visual-only alerts or metrics.
decisions.inspiration: 21st Incident Status Timeline inspected through Exa; native project DOM/SVG retained.
